Shammy-Notch-For-Windows.name: Shammy-Notch-For-Windows
Shammy-Notch-For-Windows.description: A floating island for Windows: a Dynamic Island-style notch with soft liquid light, a dial that blooms under your pointer, Stage (your script under the camera), music, calls, timers, one-time codes and laptop controls. About 90 MB idle. No paid AI.
